about: QA-AI-01 for the people assistant (NM-AI-02, 03, 06): questions asked as Ben Lim of the sample company on 20 Nov 2026, answered through the real runtime with the scripted model. A right answer names the tool it ran, cites its source and states only figures a tool returned. Synthetic data only.
